pattern_id: Race between gossip routine reading ConsensusParams and consensus state updates during finalize
description: BUG PATTERN: Race condition between gossipVotesRoutine and consensus state updates. DESCRIPTION: Data race detected between gossipVotesRoutine reading ConsensusParams.ABCI.VoteExtensionsEnabled and updateToState writing to the same field during finalizeCommit. The gossip routine runs in a separate goroutine and accesses consensus parameters without synchronization while the consensus state machine updates them. ROOT CAUSE: Consensus state (including ConsensusParams) is modified during state transitions (finalizeCommit -> updateToState) while gossip routines concurrently read these fields. No mutex or atomic access protects the shared ConsensusParams structure. LESSON: In BFT implementations, gossip routines and consensus state machines often run concurrently. Any shared state between them (params, height, round, votes) must be protected. Consider: 1) Copy-on-read for config params in gossip routines; 2) Use read-write locks if params change infrequently; 3) Pass immutable snapshots of consensus state to gossip routines; 4) Run race detector (-race flag) in CI to catch these issues early.
